facts.fact: The Knowledge Hub report says that "in 2023, a new Digital Development Policy 2023-2032 was adopted"; it names no adopting act or body and does not describe the policy's scope.

The report gives the Digital Development Policy a period of 2023-2032 and says it was adopted in 2023; it does not say whether the text is public. The report is dated December 2024, inside that period.

The report says the 'Niger 2.0' strategic plan was "launched" in 2017, with a strong focus on rural areas (the Smart Villages programme); it names no adopting act or body and does not otherwise describe its scope.

systems.tiers: Said to be adopted in 2023; scope not described.

systems.owner: Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Economy
systems.tiers: Described as the revised version of the previous Telecommunications Sectoral Policy; the ministry launched the work on it in 2021.
Launched 2017; strong focus on rural areas through the Smart Villages programme.

note: Class left empty for the 2023-2032 Digital Development Policy and for Niger 2.0 because the report does not describe their scope. The report's 2023-2032 policy and its 'Digital Niger 2021-2030' are named as separate instruments; the report does not reconcile them.
